title: Restore quiet headers and one glossy scroll bar
summary: The large coloured top mastheads are gone. Screens keep a calm in-page heading, while one slim translucent glass bar appears only after the page is scrolled.
changes: Night, Changes, Breaks and Chat no longer use the large blue-green hero masthead introduced in 38.0; their normal top-of-page headers are quiet and content-led again.
A single slim full-width glass bar now fades and glides in only after the page header scrolls away, using the same treatment across Night, Changes, Breaks, Chat, Full Roster and Roster Management.
The scroll bar shows only the current section title, removing extra status text, oversized height and the Admin-only floating rail so the chrome stays calm and predictable.
Scroll-linked blur, opacity and vertical movement are driven continuously for a smoother transition, while screen switches temporarily suppress the bar to prevent stale-header flashes.
The improved Chat readability, content hierarchy, roster calculations, handover logic, staffing rules, break logic, Supabase security and explicit PWA update activation remain unchanged.
